title: The zero current in ℝ^P is represented by the empty IMRep, whose weight is the zero measure (preliminary P4)
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ there is an integer multiplicity representation R of the zero current of ℝ^P: an IMRep R in univ ⊆ ℝ^P = Euclid P (IMRep univ n) with R.Represents (0 : GeometricCurrentOn univ n), i.e. 0(ω) = R.action ω = ∫_{R.carrier} R.mult·⟨ω, R.orient⟩ dHⁿ for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), and whose weight R.measure = (Hⁿ⌞R.carrier).withDensity R.mult is the zero measure. Here Hⁿ = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.Represents (0 : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) ∧ R.measure = 0
